content:
Margarida Amândio, AI Researcher at BUILT CoLAB, was one of the speakers at the virtual conference "Artificial Intelligence in Architecture, Engineering and Construction (AI in AEC) 2021".


This conference, held online between 24 and 25 March, featured 57 speakers, who gave 50 different presentations, attended by around 230 participants, from almost 30 countries.


Margarida's talk took place in the Autonomous Construction panel, where she presented "Artificial Intelligence Based Optimization Of Road Rehabilitation Processes", work developed together with Manuel Parente (BUILT CoLAB) and Prof. José Neves (CERIS, IST).
